outlook.statement: The Company is actively evaluating opportunities across businesses that complement its strategic capabilities and offer potential for long-term value creation, including business restructuring, diversification into new business opportunities, and other potential initiatives. The medium-term outlook for the Ferro Silicon industry remains cautiously optimistic, supported by planned expansion in steel-making capacities, infrastructure development, and continued industrial growth.
The Company is actively working on the risk related to revenue generation, asset maintenance, regulatory compliance and identification of suitable future business opportunities.
The Company is looking for new business opportunities and right now has no intention to liquidate as a business entity.
The Company intends to dispose off the aforesaid assets in the next twelve months. Negotiations with potential buyers are in progress.

The Company continues to exist as a going concern and will earn interest income from its substantial investment portfolio, which is classified as 'Other Income' in the Statement of Profit and Loss. The Company is looking for new business opportunities and right now has no intention to liquidate as a business entity.
outlook.period: At least twelve months from the date of the balance sheet (i.e., up to 31st March 2027)
